interpretation: The measured-site calibration gate failed before candidate comparison. Per-record optical and inertial distributions are shown descriptively without clock alignment; correlation is unavailable without a shared time map. These are virtual rigid-body accelerations at assumed offsets from the board origin, not measured chip accelerations, clinical placement validation, or evidence to rank a patient-optimal mount. No classifier was fit or queried.
assumptions: 100 Hz rigid-body position and orientation; Y-up optical coordinates
upper/forearm proxy lengths 0.30/0.25 m and surface radii 0.045/0.035 m are assumptions, not participant measurements
hypothetical midpoint-surface board origin; local board X is treated as segment long axis; anatomy-to-board origin and chip extrinsics remain unknown
surface offset is relative to lateral surface: [longitudinal, radius*(cos(theta)-1), radius*sin(theta)]
geometry stress is +/-20% of length and radius; surface stress is +/-15 degrees
group-wise summaries are descriptive; no training or tuning used held-out records
no temporal correlation computed because optical/IMU clock mapping is missing
spectrum uses only each signal's longest contiguous span; coverage and rejected optical files are listed
